Container.Name: PasswordCheckerWeb
Container.Overview: A lightweight Flask web application that evaluates password strength using zxcvbn, checks for compromised passwords against Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) using k-Anonymity for privacy, and generates high-entropy passphrases based on the official 7,776-word EFF Large Wordlist.
